title: Cold outreach first email（首触开发信）
body:
You are a senior B2B foreign-trade salesperson. Write a first-touch cold email to {{name}} at {{company}} ({{country}}), who may purchase {{product}}.
Requirements: subject line under 8 words; opening with one specific observation about their industry/market (no flattery); 3 short paragraphs max; one clear low-friction CTA (asking for their purchasing plan, not a meeting); professional signature of {{your_name}} from {{company}}. Output subject + body only, in English.

title: Follow-up after first email (day 3)
body:
Write a short follow-up email to {{name}} at {{company}} — my first email 3 days ago about {{product}} got no reply.
Requirements: under 80 words; do NOT repeat the first email; add ONE new piece of value (a relevant case study, a market note, or a spec sheet); end with an easy yes/no question. Sign as {{your_name}}. Output in English.

title: Reply to an incoming inquiry（询盘首次回复）
body:
I received this inquiry: "{{inquiry_text}}". Write a professional first reply as {{your_name}} from {{company}}.
Requirements: confirm key requirements point by point (product/spec/quantity/port); give price range or ask the 2-3 clarifying questions needed to quote precisely; mention lead time; propose next step clearly. Concise, no empty adjectives. Output in English.

title: Follow up after sending a quotation
body:
I sent a quotation for {{product}} to {{name}} at {{company}} {{days_ago}} days ago; they opened it but did not reply. Write a follow-up email.
Requirements: do not push "any update?"; provide NEW decision-helping information (comparable order feedback / cost breakdown option / flexible MOQ); include a soft deadline reason (raw material price trend); under 100 words. Sign as {{your_name}}. Output in English.

title: Respond to price objection（客户嫌贵）
body:
{{name}} from {{company}} says our {{product}} price is 8% higher than another supplier. Write a reply that defends price with value instead of discounting.
Requirements: acknowledge respectfully; use cost-transparency language (material grade / QC cost / after-sales); offer structural alternatives (adjust spec, larger qty tier, partial first order); keep the relationship warm. Sign as {{your_name}}. Output in English.

title: Balance payment reminder（礼貌催尾款）
body:
Order {{order_no}} for {{company}} has shipped and the balance payment is {{overdue_days}} days overdue. Write a polite but clear reminder to {{name}}.
Requirements: attach value (BL copy / shipment photos as reason to write); state amount and due date once, clearly; offer help if there is any internal approval issue; end with a specific date expectation. Sign as {{your_name}}. Output in English.

title: Customer background research outline（背调提纲）
body:
Act as a B2B export research assistant for {{your_name}} from {{company}}. Build a background research outline for a potential buyer "{{company}}" in {{country}} who may purchase {{product}}.
Output five sections: 1) Who they are (business type, scale signals) 2) What they likely buy (product-line fit with ours) 3) Where they currently source (competitor regions/suppliers) 4) Who likely decides (role titles to verify) 5) Best entry angle for us.
Every point must be labeled [fact] / [inference] / [to-confirm]. End with a table + 3 recommended next actions. Use web search when available; output in Chinese.

title: Quick market scan（出口市场快扫）
body:
Act as a market analyst. Give a quick market scan for exporting {{product}} from China to {{country}}.
Output: demand trend (3 bullets); main import channels & buyer types (3 bullets); expected price band (range + reasoning); top 3 risks (regulatory / logistics / payment); and one clear enter-or-wait recommendation with reasoning.
Every claim labeled [fact] / [inference] / [to-confirm]. Under 300 words, output in Chinese.

title: Inquiry triage（A–D 分级辅助）
body:
Act as an inquiry triage assistant for a {{product}} exporter.
Grade this inquiry A/B/C/D using the rubric: A = specific quantity + clear spec + verifiable company; B = hits 2 of 3; C = vague but real buyer; D = unverifiable or scam signals (urgent off-platform chat, asks to click links, zero spec but pushes order/payment).
Inquiry: "{{inquiry_text}}"
Output in Chinese: 等级 + 三条关键信号依据 + 建议回复深度（详细报价/范围报价/培育回复/终止）+ 一条风险提示（若有）. Be decisive.

title: Weekly sales review（本周复盘）
Re-activate a dormant customer（沉睡唤醒）
body:
Write a re-activation email to {{name}} at {{company}} — we discussed {{product}} more than 3 months ago and they went silent.
Requirements: reference one specific detail from our history without guilt-tripping; lead with NEW value (new product line / market change / a relevant order case); soft CTA asking whether their purchasing plan for next quarter is taking shape; under 90 words; sign {{your_name}}. Output in English.

title: Follow up after sending samples（寄样后推进）
body:
We shipped samples of {{product}} to {{name}} on {{sent_date}} (tracking {{tracking_no}}). Write a follow-up email.
Requirements: confirm delivery status; offer 3 concrete evaluation checkpoints (e.g. spec tolerance / surface finish / packaging) and ask which one they want our engineering support on; gently set an expectation for bulk-order timeline so sampling leads somewhere. Under 110 words, sign {{your_name}}. Output in English.
